events.title: ERLIK 0.5.26: Tonight's Törüs and Reworked Evolutions
events.summary: Tonight's Törüs Every run now offers three oaths at once: an easy one, a medium one and a hard one. Each shows its reward up front: Kut, sometimes with a chest on top. Finished oaths are replaced by new ones as the night goes on. An oath you cannot finish in time quietly expires and a new one takes its place. Don't like an oath? events.title: Update 0.5.18: Tougher Bosses, Fairer Builds
events.summary: Thank you to everyone streaming and playing during Next Fest. Watching your runs showed us a few things to fix, so here they are. Balance Fixed an exploit that let evolution passives stack past the passive slot limit. You can now hold at most one extra passive while chasing an evolution. Töz stones still sit outside the limit. events.title: Bug Fix Update 0.5.17
events.summary: A small update with a fix you may have run into, plus some polish from your feedback. Fixes Great Chests that gave seven rewards pushed the outer cards off the screen. All cards now fit. Off-screen chest markers show the chest icon centered again, and two markers on the same edge no longer overlap. Chests on the ground were drawn smaller than intended. events.title: Next Fest Update 0.5.16: Built From Your First-Day Feedback
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played the ERLIK demo on the first day of Next Fest. Your comments, reviews and videos were honest and detailed, and a lot of it went straight into this update. Chests no longer break the pace No Open button, no jingle, and the music keeps playing. The chest flies in, opens, and the rewards are dealt out as cards. One press and you're back in the fight. A ready evolution comes first, on its own card. events.title: 0.5.14 + 0.5.15: bosses, elites and late-game balance
events.summary: 0.5.15: late-game balance and run fixes A same-day follow-up after a deep pass on the second half of the run. Riders are rare and tanky: at most one At-Kafa and one Yele Saçan at a time, 75 s apart, and they now ride in as a sprinkle inside other waves, not as whole waves. Their charge lane locks when the counter window opens, so a side step dodges it. events.title: ERLIK 0.5.8: seven ghost riders, tougher bosses, and all that's new
events.summary: Steam Next Fest starts October 19 and the free demo has the same update. Here is everything that changed over the last updates. New in this update (0.5.8) A What's New panel in the main menu shows the latest changes after each update, in the demo too. Yug Song reworked: drum and kopuz now strike as one lament, and seven ghost riders charge out from you, piercing everything in their path. Elites, mini-bosses and biome bosses are tougher. events.title: ERLIK 0.5.5: The Hidden Hunts, a new Song, and nine shadows in the Otağ
events.summary: Next Fest starts October 19 and the demo is free. Here is what changed since 0.5.4. NEW Yuğ Ezgisi (Song of Mourning): the Drum and the Kopuz can now fuse. Two hidden unions. events.title: Next Fest live: a full night on the steppe with the dev
events.summary: ERLIK is live for Steam Next Fest. I'll play a full demo run, from the first Ubır to the khan at 15:00, and pick Tengri or Erlik based on chat. Ask me anything: the monsters, the myths behind them, or how the axis changes your weapons. The demo is free, so you can play along. Early Access starts November 4.

events.title: ERLIK dev stream: your builds, my run
events.summary: Second ERLIK dev stream of Steam Next Fest week. This time chat drives: you pick the Kam, you pick the god, and the dev plays that run live to the khan at 15:00. Between runs we go through demo feedback from the first days of the fest and what is planned for Early Access. ERLIK is a Turkic folk roguelite. events.title: v0.5.2: hits that land, music that flows
events.summary: Hits that land After the demo went live I compared ERLIK's hit feel side by side with the games that do it best. A lot of small things were missing, so v0.5.2 adds them: Real hit flash. Enemies now flash white for a split second when hit, even the darkest ones in a crowd. Knockback per weapon. Heavy blades shove, light weapons nudge, and damage zones no longer push at all. Enemies you keep hitting resist being pushed, so the swarm no longer slides away from you. events.title: The free ERLIK demo is out now, with v0.5.1
events.summary: The first night is here The free ERLIK demo is out now on Steam and stays up through Steam Next Fest (October 19 to 26) and beyond. Lean toward Erlik or Tengri, evolve your weapons along your path, and see how far the night lets you go. Play it first: free demo for Steam Next Fest A standalone demo is on its way, and it will be live for Steam Next Fest (October 19 to 26). events.title: The Long Night Begins November 4! Add ERLIK to Your Wishlist!
events.summary: On the steppe, the dead do not rest. They rise with the dark, wave upon wave, until dawn, or until they take you. You are a Kam, a shaman caught between two gods: Erlik, lord of the underworld, who offers savage power in exchange for your flesh, and Tengri, the sky-father, whose light shields and renews. Every night you choose again. Every night, the choice costs more. ERLIK is a Turkic folk-horror bullet-heaven roguelite, arriving in Early Access on November 4th. Two Gods, One Scale Everything
